title: Bradley-Terry model under general comparison graphs
summary: The Bradley-Terry model is a parametric model for ranking from pairwise comparisons. Existing asymptotic theory for the maximum likelihood estimator (MLE) in regimes where the number of objects grows often requires homogeneity assumptions or compatibility conditions on comparison graphs, which limits its applicability to many practical settings. In this work, we establish uniform consistency of the MLE under general deterministic comparison designs.
